Request outbound help HOW MUTUAL ACCEPTANCE WORKS Two adults, two explicit decisions A linked guardian requests outbound or return help for one child and event version. Another active team guardian offers seats and accepts the driver side. The requesting guardian reviews the named adult, direction, seats, and event version. Only that second acceptance changes the Event Passport to assigned. A schedule change makes earlier acceptance need review. Withdrawal is attributed and returns responsibility to unassigned. No automation, coach note, or chat reply can assign a driver.
